title: BPP feature_info request (DESIGN.md §14.6 negotiation family): argument-free feature-bundle read
description: Available on each advertised surface to a bounded pre-auth client or any actor valid for that surface; closure is endpoint/version only, fenced by parser and rate limits (§14.7). feature_info is a read: meta is absent by construction. DESIGN.md defines no request arguments for feature_info; this schema pins the envelope only.
